title: ExRole: From Team Trajectories to Executable Roles in Multi-Agent Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.11949v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Roles provide an interpretable interface for organizing language-model agents, yet most multi-agent systems treat them as hand-written prompt labels disconnected from learned behavior and parameter updates. We argue that a useful role should instead be an executable control variable: it should summarize behavior predictive of future utility, guide subsequent interaction, and identify the trainable capacity responsible for that behavior. We introduce ExRole, a trajectory-to-role framework that learns future-aware role prototypes from prefix-local team traces, resolves them into readable instructions and token-aligned role markers, and optionally routes shared LoRA rank slots with turn-aligned credit. Across MuSiQue and 2WikiMultiHopQA, ExRole improves over single-agent search by 15.0/14.4 and 13.5/16.1 EM/F1 points, respectively. Against the strongest non-ExRole controls, the corresponding gains remain 11.5/11.6 and 7.7/9.7 points. Across

translated_title: ExRole：从团队轨迹到多智能体语言模型中的可执行角色
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.11949v1 公告类型：新 摘要：角色为组织语言模型智能体提供了可解释的接口，但大多数多智能体系统将它们视为手写的提示标签，与学习行为和参数更新脱节。我们认为，有用的角色应是一种可执行的控制变量：它应总结对未来效用有预测性的行为，指导后续交互，并识别负责该行为的可训练能力。我们引入了ExRole，一个从轨迹到角色的框架，它从前缀局部的团队轨迹中学习具有未来意识的角色原型，将其解析为可读指令和令牌对齐的角色标记，并可选地通过回合对齐的信用分配共享LoRA秩槽。在MuSiQue和2WikiMultiHopQA上，ExRole分别比单智能体搜索提高了15.0/14.4和13.5/16.1的EM/F1分数。与最强的非ExRole对照组相比，相应增益仍为11.5/11.6和7.7/9.7分。
tldr: ExRole框架将团队轨迹转化为可执行角色，通过未来感知的原型学习、可读指令生成和LoRA信用分配，在多跳问答任务中显著提升了性能。
en_tdlr: ExRole converts team trajectories into executable roles via future-aware prototype learning, readable instruction generation, and LoRA credit assignment, substantially improving multi-hop QA performance.
